name: 은백·금색 대검 기사
processing: New native-alpha articulated body poses. Cyan/magenta markers determine actual rigid hilt axis and occluded-fist pivot. Markers removed; immutable original sword is uniformly scaled to anatomical body scale, rigidly rotated and translated; original closed glove pixels composited in foreground. Ground foot anchors remain fixed during strikes. No weapon redraw, warp, still transforms counted as new poses, or root-y contact cheating.
